# aap_eda_decision_environment (Data Source)

Get decision environment datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_eda_decision_environment" "example-id" {
  id = "1"
}

data "aap_eda_decision_environment" "example-name" {
  name = "Example Decision Environment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Decision Environment ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the EDA Decision Environment.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the EDA Decision Environment.
- `eda_credential_id` (Number) The EDA credential ID associated with the EDA Decision Environment.
- `image_url` (String) The image URL for the EDA Decision Environment.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA Decision Environment.
- `pull_policy` (String) The pull policy for the EDA Decision Environment. Either `always` or `never`.
